title.description: A short name for the shot, e.g. "The elevator light stutters"

idea.description: One or two sentences: what the viewer sees, and why the library cannot show it

at.description: A word in this scene, "<lineId>:<wordIndex>" with the index from the input

source.description: The complete TSX file: the default export is the component
